requirements: options.dependencies maps an event id to prerequisite event ids.
An event may be emitted only after all of its prerequisite ids have been emitted.
If eligible events contain a dependency cycle or a missing eligible prerequisite, throw an error.
When several events are dependency-ready, preserve the v2 deterministic ordering among ready events.
Blocked or below-min-sequence prerequisite events make their dependents unresolved and therefore an error.
